title: C24/2/2018 of Smt Disha Agarwal Vs Gaurav Agarwal

paras.text:
C-24 No. 02 of 2018
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Advocate for the
applicant-wife.
By means of present application filed
under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure,
the applicant seeks to transfer the proceedings of
the Petition no.639 of 2017, titled as, Gaurav
Agarwal vs Smt. Disha Agarwal, from the
Family Court, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh
Nagar to the Family Court, Kotdwar, District
Pauri Garhwal.
The coordinate Bench of this Court, vide
order dated 14.02.2018, directed the petitioner to
serve the respondent dasti besides normal mode
of service and stayed the proceedings of the
aforementioned petition, but the applicant has not
yet taken steps for service of notice upon the
respondent.
Since the petitioner fails to take steps on
this ground alone petition is liable to be
dismissed. Even otherwise, no good ground is
made out to transfer the proceedings of aforesaid
case from the Family Court, Rudrapur, District
Udham Singh Nagar to the Family Court,
Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal.
Accordingly, C-24 application fails and
is hereby dismissed.
